not_covered.text: At least 11 Palestinians, including four children, are injured during a raid by Israeli settlers and soldiers in Nablus in the occupied West Bank. Israeli soldiers also detain at least ten people from Nablus, Tell, Salim, and Bethlehem.
The Human Rights Watch reports that an Sukhoi Su-24 airstrike by the Russian paramilitary group Africa Corps in Mali's Mopti region killed eight civilians in June.
A bus en route to Algiers, Algeria, plunges into a deep ravine in El Kerma after skidding off the road, killing 25 people and injuring 44 others.
At least 34 miners are killed in a methane gas explosion at a coal mine near Quetta, Pakistan.

A Sri Lankan court sentences former police chief Pujith Jayasundara to death for negligence in failing to prevent the 2019 Easter bombings, which killed 279 people. Sri Lanka has not carried out an execution since 1976.
Indonesian authorities announces it arrested a Malaysia Airlines pilot for allegedly smuggling over {{cvt|26|kg|lbs}} of ecstasy and a package of methamphetamine into Jakarta International Airport.
The Bulgaria National Assembly sets October 25th as the date for the presidential election.
